title: Tafsir: Understanding the Qur'an (Zubdah At-Tafsir)
description: Learning tafsir (explanation of the Qur'an) from the Salafi methodology. Start with Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan's introduction to Tafsir Ibn Kathir (the most important classical tafsir, by Imam Ibn Kathir), then study Juz 'Amma verse-by-verse through Zubdah At-Tafsir - the condensed commentary of the Salafi scholars, taught by Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan (Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy).
short_description: Tafsir of the Quran with the Salafi methodology

modules.title: Introduction to Tafsir
modules.description: Why we study tafsir and how the Salaf approached it.

lessons.title: New || Introduction To Tafseer Ibn Kathir || AMAU Academy
lessons.content: A complete introduction to Tafsir Ibn Kathir: its author (Imam Ibn Kathir, died 774 AH), his sources, his methodology, and why it remains the benchmark Salafi tafsir. Ramadan 2025 session from AMAU Academy.

modules.title: Juz 'Amma — Surah by Surah (Zubdah At-Tafsir)
modules.description: Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan's explanation of Juz 'Amma from Zubdah At-Tafsir (the "distillation" of the classical tafsirs, prepared by the Salafi scholars), SOK Academy, Garden of Ilm.

lessons.title: L1 | Surah An-Naba (78)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah An-Naba (The News) - the great event awaiting mankind. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L2 | Surah An-Naaziat (79)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah An-Naaziat (Those Who Pluck Out) - the angels of death and resurrection. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L4 | Surah At-Takwir (81)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah At-Takwir (The Folding Up) - the signs of the Day of Judgment and the truth of revelation. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L8 | Surah Al-Buruj (85)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Al-Buruj (The Constellations) - the story of the people of the ditch; the believers' steadfastness. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L10 | Surah Al-A'la (87)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Al-A'la (The Most High) - glorifying Allah and the purpose of creation and the hereafter. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L12 | Surah Al-Fajr (89)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Al-Fajr (The Dawn) - oaths, the people of 'Ad, Thamud and Fir'awn, and the purified soul at peace. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L15 | Surah Al-Layl (92)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Al-Layl (The Night) - the two paths: the generous and the miserly. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L17 | Surah Ash-Sharh (94)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Ash-Sharh (The Opening) - the Prophet's expansion of the chest and the removal of his burden. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L19 | Surah Al-Alaq (96)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Al-Alaq (The Clot) - the first revelation: read in the name of your Lord, and man's transgression. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.

lessons.title: L21 | Surah Al-Bayyinah (98)
lessons.content: Tafsir of Surah Al-Bayyinah (The Clear Proof) - the clear proof has come, and those who follow it are the best of creation. Garden of Ilm / SOK Academy.
